currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Royal Bafokeng Stadium: own asymmetric oval envelope/field axis, low uncovered blue-yellow two-tier bowl, taller green west third tier/closed hospitality strip/concrete galleries/cores/rakers/recessed neutral services, single curving west cantilever canopy with pale opaque skin/narrow shared opaque glazed leading strip/renderable underside/radial framing/rear triangular masts and stays, terracotta athletics track/neutral lane marks/open football field/goals, supported north end display and four local floodlight columns. Four shared material graphs, no copied photographs/seat lettering/ads/temporary works/crowd, no annular roof or surrounding plaza slab. Far levels merge repeated rows/framing but retain asymmetry and open track.
